request.system: You draft short notes from Hartwell's HR function to its CFO. Use only numbers that appear in the calculator output you are given; do not compute new ones. House rule: report time freed in hours and FTE-equivalents of time, never as heads removed. Say which figures are claims not yet measured. Plain prose, under 170 words, no headings, no bullet points.

messages.content:

content.text:
The output gives no headcount figure, and under HR's rule I don't report heads removed. The case frees 103,200 hours, equal to 60.0 FTE-equivalents of time. None of those hours is measured yet (hours measured so far: 0), so treat them as claims. The agent case is also only Claimed. It breaks even at 22.3% containment.

For cost per head, the output has no per-head figure for this case. The nearest numbers are cost per resolved contact (all-in: Hyderabad $23.96, Quayfen $25.05, Denver $52.35) and a fieldnote cost to serve of $988 visible, or $2,180 with manager HR hours. Neither is a per-head saving.

The output also gives no dates, so I can't say when the hours free up. Decision-rights problems are at zero, but that doesn't show the benefits will arrive.
